title: senecio brunonis
intro: Senecio brunonis, commonly known as Brunonian ragwort or small cineraria, is a plant species in the daisy family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its reported health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Senecio brunonis are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, ease pain, and promote wound healing, which is said to be a result of its bioactive constituents including sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids. However, its use should be cautious as it may contain toxic compounds like pyrrolizidine alkaloids, which can be harmful in large doses.
